ai_apply_done: The suggestion has been written in (one undo step)
ai_apply_not_found: Could not find that spot in the text — it may have changed
ai_card_btn_comment: Put the suggestion in the margin as a comment
ai_comment_added: The suggestion is now a comment in the margin
ai_comment_exists: The suggestion is already a comment at that spot
ai_review_no_issues: No issues detected! Your writing looks crisp and clear.
ai_review_short_text: Document is too short. Write at least a sentence to analyze.
analysis_note_capitalisation: Both upper and lower case spellings occur
analysis_note_repeat: once close together, {total} in the book, closest {gap} words apart|{n} times close together, {total} in the book, closest {gap} words apart
ask_answered: Answered from {count} part of the manuscript.|Answered from {count} parts of the manuscript.
ask_context_idle: The selection is built when you type a question.
ask_context_summary: {items} part · ~{tokens} tokens are sent|{items} parts · ~{tokens} tokens are sent
ask_empty_context: The selection came out empty — open a scene or ask about something the manuscript mentions.
ask_no_endpoint: No AI provider is chosen. Pick one in Settings → AI — nothing was sent.
ask_placeholder: Ask about people, places or anything in the manuscript
autocorrect_done: {n} correction: typography and words|{n} corrections: typography and words
binder_delete_text: Delete “{title}” and {count} node(s) beneath it? The text is removed from disk.
chart_pie_single_series_hint: Pie charts only use a single data series.
code_no_blocks: No code block found. Write [kodblock] … [/kodblock] first.
codex_created: {name} was added to the story bible
codex_delete_ask: Delete {name}? The scenes and the manuscript are untouched.
codex_deleted: {name} was removed from the story bible
codex_graph_hint: Every node is a codex entry and every edge a relation. Clicking a node selects the entry in the panel.
codex_graph_tooltip: Draw the codex as a graph
codex_mentions: Mentioned {n} time in the manuscript|Mentioned {n} times in the manuscript
codex_no_project: Open a project first — the story bible belongs to the book
codex_relation_kind: How are they connected? (mother, rival, colleague)
codex_relation_none: There is nobody else in the codex to link to yet
codex_summary_hint: One line to recognise them by
collections_delete_ask: Delete the collection “{name}”? The scenes stay in the manuscript.
collections_empty: No collections yet. ＋ makes a group, 🔍 a saved search.
collections_no_project: Open a project to collect scenes.
collections_read: Read the collection as one text
collections_read_empty: The collection is empty — nothing to read
collections_search_readonly: A saved search owns its hits. Change the query instead of adding by hand.
collections_toggle: Add or remove the selected scene
colophon_rights: The author {author} holds the rights to the text.
comment_no_selection: Select a passage first — the comment hangs on what you select.
comment_quote_gone: That passage is no longer in the scene.
compile_done: {count} file written to {folder}.|{count} files written to {folder}.
compile_no_selection: Select text in the editor first, or choose “Everything that is open”.
compile_nothing: Nothing was written — check the folder.
compile_per_chapter: One file per chapter (otherwise one file for everything)
compile_template_hint: {n} is the chapter number, {title} its heading, {project} the book's name
context_hint: Every part with the reason it is included and its size. Codex entries can be set to: always, on mention, or never.
corkboard_empty: No scenes in the project yet.
cover_done_text:
The sheet is in {path}.

Size: {width} × {height} mm
Spine: {spine} mm

The fold marks are drawn and the book's details are in place. Lay the design on top — the base is ready.
cover_footer: Cover sheet {width} × {height} mm · spine {spine} mm · {channel} · fold marks drawn
cover_no_sizes: The channel or format gives no cover size to compute.
cover_no_trim_text: Choose channel and format in File → Publishing… first — the cover size belongs to the channel, not to the book.
dictation_push_to_talk: Hold Space or Click to Speak
dlg_save_changes_text: The document '{name}' has unsaved changes. Do you want to save before closing?
elements_hint: Fictionary asks these questions for every scene. Answer in a few words — empty answers become gaps in the Story Map.
entity_summary_hint: One line to recognise them by
epubcheck_clean: No errors and no warnings. The book is clean.
epubcheck_missing_title: EPUBCheck is not on this computer
events_hint: An event has a time in the story and the scenes it plays out in. The same event can belong to several scenes — link it with the buttons, which apply to the scene you have open.
exercise_empty: No suggestions came back — try again.
exercise_intro: Pick a question. The suggestions are ways in, not finished prose — the one you choose lands in the scene's own note.
exercise_needs_scene: Open a scene first — the exercise needs a context
exercise_saved: The suggestion is in the scene's note
field_inserted: {kind} inserted — the number is counted from the order in the text
fmt_converted: {n} marker became a block|{n} markers became blocks
fmt_problems: The document has markers that did not become blocks:
fmt_typo: Line {line}: {raw} is not a marker I recognise
fmt_unclosed: Line {line}: [{kind}] was never closed — left untouched
gfonts_preview_text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
gfonts_search_placeholder: Search Google Fonts (e.g. Poppins, Lora, Playfair, Inter)...
ghost_instruction_ph: e.g. 'conclude the argument' or 'mention the counter-arguments'
ghost_mode_angle_hint: Proposes different directions the text could take from here.
ghost_mode_continue_hint: Writes the next paragraph in the same voice. Pick the option you like.
ghost_mode_expand_hint: Turns the instruction (or the end of the text) into running prose.
ghost_mode_unstick_hint: Asks concrete questions based on what you have written, to get you moving again.
ghost_need_text: The document is empty — write a few lines first, or give a direction
ghost_style_ref_file: Pick a file as voice reference
ghost_subtitle: Continues your text in your voice, based on what you have already written.
graph_hint: Click a note to open it. Dashed circles are links to notes that do not exist yet — click one to create it.
graph_node_missing: No note yet — click to create
grid_events_tooltip: The story's events, linked to scenes
grid_no_project: Open a project first — the grid shows its scenes
history_no_diff: No difference from the text now.
history_review_tip: Compare the point with the scene as it is now, and decide per paragraph
img_choose_placeholder: Select or drag an image file...
inline_ai_placeholder: Ask AI to edit, rephrase, expand, format, or type a custom prompt...
insight_no_place: This finding points at no place in the text.
insight_quote_gone: The passage is gone — the scene has changed since the analysis.
inspector_idle: No review yet. Press ⟳ to review the text.
instructions_label: What should the AI keep to in this book? (tone, tense, names, anything that must stay consistent)
language_hint: The text is sent to {endpoint} for checking. A private server is set in the settings.
log_csv_failed: Could not save the writing log: {error}
log_sprint_done: Sprint finished: {minutes} minutes, {n} word|Sprint finished: {minutes} minutes, {n} words
log_status: 🖋 {n} word today · 🔥 {streak} days|🖋 {n} words today · 🔥 {streak} days
menu_file_review: Review changes since the last point…
name_empty: The name came out empty — nothing to add
notes_create_confirm: There is no note called "{title}". Create it?
notes_no_vault: No vault yet — choose a folder with 📂
notes_not_in_vault: This document is not in the vault
overview_blurb_hint: A short pitch — what should make someone open the book
overview_isbn_hint: The book's ISBN, if it has one
overview_publisher_hint: The publisher or your own name
overview_synopsis_hint: The whole story, for publishers and reviewers
pagesetup_clean_print_hint: Paper becomes white, text black, and rules grey. Tinted colours from the app theme or pasted text turn grey instead of travelling into the file.
pagesetup_grayscale_images: Convert embedded images to grayscale on export
pagesetup_grayscale_images_hint: Photos and screenshots print neutrally. Off by default — images are content.
pagesetup_mirror_tip: Odd pages get the inner margin on the left, even pages on the right — as in a printed book. The text keeps the same width on both.
pagesetup_page_start_tip: Front matter is often left out; page 1 of the book may be sheet 9.
pagesetup_print_scale_tip: Scales the text on paper but leaves the sheet and margins. 80 % fits more characters per line, 120 % fewer.
pause_reminder: Time to straighten your back and look out the window for a while
prepress_clean: No solitary lines across a page break.
prepress_found: {widows} paragraphs end with a solitary line (widow), {orphans} begin with one (orphan).
prepress_held: {count} paragraph now held together — undo with Ctrl+Z.|{count} paragraphs now held together — undo with Ctrl+Z.
prepress_held_message: {count} paragraph held together|{count} paragraphs held together
prepress_no_ghostscript: Ghostscript is missing — PDF/X-1a requires it. Install it with your package manager.
prepress_pdfx_unverified: The file could not be confirmed as PDF/X — it is not print-ready.
project_broken_text:
The project opens, but something is wrong:

{problems}
project_open_error_text:
This is not an Scribentia project.

{error}
project_tpl_enkel_desc: One chapter and one scene — you build the rest yourself.
project_tpl_fackbok_desc: Chapters with sections, no parts. 40,000 words suggested.
project_tpl_hjaltens_resa_desc: Campbell's twelve stages as chapters, from the ordinary world to the return.
project_tpl_mysteriet_desc: The crime, the investigation, the false lead, the reveal — nine beats as chapters.
project_tpl_novell_desc: A single scene to write in. 8,000 words suggested.
project_tpl_roman_desc: Parts, chapters and scenes. 80,000 words suggested.
project_tpl_save_the_cat_desc: Snyder's fifteen beats as chapters, one per beat. The structure is ready, the text is empty.
project_tpl_tre_akter_desc: Setup, confrontation, resolution — one act per part.
publish_applied: Page settings applied: inner margin {gutter} mm, outer edge {outer} mm
publish_ebook_numbers: An ebook has no print measurements — trim, gutter and spine apply to the paper book. Requirements: {source}
publish_large_print: Large print — larger type and leading
publish_number_gutter_unknown: Inner margin: no published ladder for this channel — use the channel's template
publish_number_spine_unknown: Spine width: no published formula for this channel — use the channel's template
readability_on: Heavy sentences are marked — shorten where you can
release_check_errors: EPUBCheck found {errors} errors in the book.
release_cover_failed: The cover sheet could not be drawn: {error}
release_done_text: The package is in {folder} with {count} file.|The package is in {folder} with {count} files.
release_epub_failed: The EPUB could not be written: {error}
release_no_blurb: The back-cover text is empty — it is the first thing a shop shows.
release_no_folder: No release folder yet — run File → Release the book… first.
release_no_isbn: No ISBN — without it the book cannot be ordered in a bookshop.
release_no_profile: No print profile is chosen — run Publishing… first, or nobody knows how the book is to be cut.
release_odd_pages: The page count is odd ({pages}) — the book gets a blank last page.
release_pdf_failed: The print PDF could not be written.
release_unchecked: EPUBCheck could not run ({reason}) — the book is not checked.
research_hint_ask: Answers from the model's own knowledge — no sources. Verify anything important.
research_hint_search: Searching via {url}, then reading the top hits.
research_hint_url: Paste one or more addresses. The pages are read and summarised with source references.
research_need_input: Type a question or an address first
research_no_searxng: No SearXNG address configured. Add one under Settings → Vault & research (enable 'json' under search.formats).
research_no_sources_warn: No sources — the model's own knowledge
research_ph_ask: What do you want to know?
research_ph_url: https://example.com or several addresses separated by spaces
research_tab_hint: Research belongs to the project but is not part of the manuscript.
review_formatting: Same text, different formatting in {n} paragraphs — formatting is kept apart from the changes
review_no_point: No point to compare against yet — open the history and save one
review_none: No changes since the last point
scene_comment_resolve: Mark as resolved, or back to a working note
scene_comments_hint: Comments attached to a passage. Click a row to jump to it in the text.
scene_entities_hint: People, places and things in this scene. The link lives in the project codex.
scene_entities_mentioned: {count} is mentioned in the text but not linked|{count} are mentioned in the text but not linked
scene_entity_link: Link an entity to the scene
scene_material_hint: Research notes attached to this scene. Double-click to open.
scene_material_link: Attach research material to the scene
scene_no_project: Open a project to see the scene's details.
scene_note_hint: Your own note about the scene. Stays in the project, never in the text.
scrivenings_cut: Showing {limit} scenes; {cut} more are left out.
settings_ai_fetch_models_tip: Asks the provider's own /models instead of the app guessing names.
settings_ai_hint: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Other providers work the same way — change address, key and model.
settings_ai_test_empty: The model replied with empty text.
settings_ai_test_missing: Fill in the endpoint and model first.
settings_vault_hint: The vault is a folder of Markdown/text files that link to each other with [[wikilinks]]. Point it at an existing Obsidian vault, or at a new folder.
spell_unavailable: The language service is not answering ({error}) — the text cannot be checked now
start_new_doc_sub: Start writing on a blank page
start_open_doc_sub: Open an existing document from disk
start_tagline: Modern, AI-powered writing & rich text editor
start_templates_doc_sub: Choose from templates like report, thesis, meeting minutes
style_note_scenes: once in total, densest in {title}|{total} times in total, densest in {title}
tb_style_message_tooltip: Text message or chat — narrower column, fixed pitch (Ctrl+Alt+8)
tb_style_verse_tooltip: Verse block — line breaks are kept (Ctrl+Alt+7)
templates_dialog_sub: Pick a ready-made template — clean black-and-white documents that go straight to PDF, print, or Word.
toc_inserted: The table of contents has been inserted
toc_none: No headings to build a table of contents from
toc_updated: The table of contents has been updated
variants_applied: {count} scene was moved in the manuscript.|{count} scenes were moved in the manuscript.
variants_hint: A variant is a named ordering of the scenes. The content is the same — only the order differs. "Apply" makes the variant's order the manuscript's.
variants_missing: {count} scene is missing from the variant|{count} scenes are missing from the variant
variants_moved: {count} scene is in a different order|{count} scenes are in a different order
variants_new_label: What should the variant be called?
variants_outside: {count} scene is not in the manuscript|{count} scenes are not in the manuscript
variants_same: The variant follows the manuscript order.
warn_bleed_channel_specific: Bleed differs between channels — check the channel's guide
warn_kdp_min_pages: KDP does not accept fewer than 24 pages
warn_no_spine_text: Below 79 pages there is no room for spine text
warn_odd_pages: The page count is rounded up to an even number
warn_over_last_gutter: More pages than the ladder covers — check the inner margin
warn_use_channel_template: This channel refers to its own template — verify the measurements there
